title: Calculate completed debits per merchant
sqlValidation:
SELECT merchantId, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS totalDebits
FROM dbo.WalletTransactions
WHERE status = 'completed'
  AND transactionType = 'debit'
GROUP BY merchantId
ORDER BY merchantId;
sqlExpectedResult: Totals match the expected debit ledger for each merchant. If no debits exist in the current dataset, the query should return no rows.
